Do not disclose vulnerabilities or private data here. Follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for sensitive reports.

## Expected behavior

What should happen under the current documented contract?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead? Include the first decisive error rather than only the final symptom.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest commands, target path, and inputs needed to reproduce the issue. Remove credentials, private paths, logs, and unrelated project material.

## Current source

State the commit or source snapshot only when it matters to reproducing the defect. Say whether local changes were present.

## Evidence

Paste concise output or attach a minimal safe artifact. Distinguish source inspection, static validation, sandbox staging, and any manual host behavior.

## Scope notes

List anything intentionally not tested, including host, model, permissions, authentication, or network behavior.
